criterion_fired: Criterion 2 (Carry-forward Consistency) and Criterion 4 (Actionable Next Steps)
suggested_change: Criterion 2 should allow implicit carry-forward statements ('maintained at X/10 - no new information') without requiring the exception clause on every single component. Criterion 4 should clarify: next steps must include either a specific confirmed date, '[contact TBD]', or 'pending confirmation' — but placeholder phrases like '[specific date this week]' should not be flagged as violations if no actual date was confirmed during the call.
